config.subject: A robot discovering a forgotten garden in a cyberpunk city
config.task_description: Generate comic book for 'A robot discovering a forgotten garden in a cyberpunk city'

script.title: Neon Chlorophyll
script.premise: In a rain-slicked megacity where "green" is just a color on a neon sign, an obsolete maintenance droid discovers a crack in the foundation of a skyscraper that leads to a forgotten, self-sustaining greenhouse.

characters.name: UNIT 7-B ("Seven")
characters.description: A bulky, outdated sanitation and repair droid. He is built for utility, not aesthetics.
characters.visual_traits: Boxy torso with rusted orange plating; a single, large circular optic sensor that glows a soft, flickering blue; hydraulic limbs that hiss with steam; various tools (wrenches, welders) integrated into his forearms.

frames.description: An extreme wide shot of "Sector 4." Massive skyscrapers block the sky, draped in holographic advertisements for "Synthetic Air." Rain falls in heavy, grey sheets.
frames.caption: The city is a machine that forgot how to turn off. It eats light and spits out smoke.

frames.description: A medium shot of UNIT 7-B in a narrow, trash-filled alleyway. He is hunched over, welding a leaking pipe. Sparks fly, illuminating the grime on his chassis.
frames.caption: My directive is simple: Fix the leaks. Clear the clogs. Keep the rot from showing.

frames.description: Close-up on Seven’s optic sensor. It reflects a flickering pink neon sign from across the street. Below the sensor, a small, organic green leaf is stuck in a puddle of oil near his foot.

rows.visual_description: A three-frame sequence establishing the oppressive, mechanical atmosphere of the city and Seven’s mundane existence.

frames.description: Seven pulls back a heavy, rusted corrugated metal sheet covering a hole in the base of the "Aether Corp" tower.
frames.caption: The blueprints say this is solid duracrete. The blueprints are lying.

frames.description: Seven squeezes his bulky frame through the dark aperture. Only his blue eye-light cuts through the darkness. Sound Effect: SCREEEEE—GRIND.

A wide "reveal" shot from behind Seven. He is standing on a ledge overlooking a sunken, Victorian-style glass conservatory hidden deep within the building's hollow foundation. Soft, natural-looking light (from hidden UV lamps) illuminates a riot of ferns, roses, and moss.
frames.caption: It’s a ghost. A ghost made of chlorophyll and silence.

rows.visual_description: Seven follows the source of the "biomass," leading him to a hidden structural failure in a massive corporate spire.

frames.description: Seven kneels beside a patch of white lilies. His heavy, scarred metal finger reaches out toward a delicate petal.
frames.caption: My sensors don't have a setting for "soft."

frames.description: Extreme close-up of the metal fingertip touching the petal. A drop of water transfers from the flower to the robot’s rusted casing.
frames.caption: It’s cold. But not like the rain outside. This is... quiet cold.

frames.description: A small, real butterfly (monarch) lands on Seven’s shoulder. He remains perfectly still, his optic sensor dimming as if in awe.

rows.visual_description: A quiet, intimate moment where the mechanical meets the biological.

frames.description: Seven is back at the entrance of the hole. He is pulling the rusted metal sheet back into place, carefully concealing the garden from the alleyway.
frames.caption: The city doesn't deserve this. It would just turn it into a premium subscription service.

frames.description: Seven stands back in the rain, his welding tool sparking as he "seals" the metal sheet shut, effectively locking the garden away from the world. Sound Effect: ZZZZZT-KRRRK.
Seven walks away into the foggy distance of the alley. In the foreground, on the ground where he stood, lies a single white petal, glowing faintly against the black oil.
frames.caption: Some leaks aren't meant to be fixed. Some things are better left forgotten.

rows.visual_description: Seven makes a choice to protect the sanctuary, returning to the harsh world outside.
